glossary.definition: 1 − Fidelity. Operation error shown as a probability and, where useful, as %.
Systematic unitary error, for example detuning or over-rotation.
Stochastic degradation such as dephasing, scattering or loss.
Population outside the computational space; should not be silently collapsed into a scalar depolarizing error.
Error mechanisms induced by velocity/temperature distributions and motion.
Power Spectral Density; spectral representation of noise used to connect noise to operation sensitivity.
Unexplained difference between observed KPI and predicted/attributed KPI; stays visible as Unknown / Unassigned.
Kcurrent − Kafter realistic mitigation i. More actionable than ranking only by present contributor size.

maturity_framework.question: Is there a reproducible observable/evidence record?
Is there a quantitative mapping to the local KPI?
Do model and benchmark agree within accepted uncertainty/residual?
Has the error channel been carried to relevant circuit/QEC context?
Is there a target derived from a higher-level KPI?
Is there a mitigation, predicted gain, owner and acceptance test?
Was the improvement executed and re-closed with new evidence?
